nom: COSRX BHA Blackhead Power Liquid Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced blackheads, smaller-looking pores and better oil control with consistent use over weeks to months, though one reviewer with oily, acne-prone, large-pored skin says it did absolutely nothing for her blackheads or pores after months of daily use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, slightly-oily-t-zone skin saw no significant change in her blackheads after months of use, while another with combination, acne-prone, sensitive skin says it cleared her open blackheads and rough texture.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers describe their skin as sensitive and report the product was gentle, even calming, when introduced gradually, but a few with reactive skin experienced burning, stinging or irritation, especially when used too often or applied all over the face at once.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it helped with congestion and hormonal acne without causing redness, though one initially found it made her skin very dry until she cut back on frequency.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes mature, oily, reactive skin says the product made a genuine, deep-down difference where many others had failed.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who stick with it over weeks to months report fewer blackheads, smaller pores, and calmer cystic or hormonal breakouts, often after an initial purging period of worse breakouts; however, a notable share of reviewers, mostly one-star, say it did nothing for their blackheads or even made their breakouts worse.
concerns.dehydration: The product is described as drying by several reviewers, especially with daily use at first, but many say this eases once they reduce frequency or pair it with a heavier moisturizer, and others report no dryness at all.
concerns.redness: A dry, sensitive reviewer with hormonal acne reports zero redness and calls it the calmest her skin has been in years, while a reviewer with rosacea-prone, oily skin used it successfully for oil control despite her redness-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily skin report noticeably less shine and smaller-looking pores with consistent use.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report old acne scars and dark marks fading faster than usual with regular use.

aspects.libelle: Pump tends to leak or bubble out product
Noticeable smell at application that fades quickly
A little goes a long way, bottle lasts a long time
Requires a slow, gradual introduction to avoid over-drying or purging
Works well as a targeted spot treatment or on body areas

extraits.texte: Writing this review on 10/1/24, I purchased this product in July 2024 and have been using it daily since, sometimes twice a day. So I feel I have had plenty of time using it to write my honest review. I have very oily skin with large pores, and very occasional dryness, also acne prone. It has done absolutely nothing for my blackheads or my pores. The product goes on easily and absorbs fast, but thats about all I like about it. I am pretty disappointed since it has such great reviews, unfortunately it just hasn't worked for me. I will not repurchase and i homestly wouldn't recommend anyone else to either.

I originally bought this to try and get rid of the blackheads on and around my nose. Pre-face - I have combination skin with a slightly oily t-zone. I've been using it since March of this year and haven't noticed any significant difference in less blackheads or anything. I don't think the product is worth your money, furthermore, it does close to nothing for pores, blackheads, etc.

If you're a person that needs instant gratification, look elsewhere. If you want a product that you can commit to using consistently in your facial routine and can wait a while before seeing results that are not short-term fixes, then this product is for you. (A little about my skin - I have large pores and oily skin. So my skin is predisposed to blackheads and whiteheads. I also have rosacea and my skin easily reddens.) I was about 2/3 through my first bottle before I looked in the mirror and though "Wow… the blackheads I've had my whole life on my chin are almost all gone and the ones on my nose are significantly less." The first couple weeks i wasnt too excited because i did note it causing some dry skin. But it was mild and a change of my moisturizer solved the problem. I use two pumps that I put in the palms of my hands and then pat all over my face, under my chin and chest. I use this morning and night. Its the only product i use for both morning and night routines. It has a very faint chemical smell but it dries fairly quick and the smell doesn't last at all. Blackheads are about 75% less than before and i hardly ever get zits now. I'm nealy done with my second bottle and will definitely buy again.

This is a highly effective product if you know how to use it and what products not to mix it with. I have sensitive, combination, acne prone skin. My skin is also use to using acid based products. If you have congested pores, which I had pretty bad in my t-zone area, this is for you! It helped to clear my open blackheads and get rid of their rough bumpy texture. My forehead is starting to get that glassy clear flat look again. The ingredients in this products and levels of concentration are amazingggg.

At first I was like wow my face is getting worse this sucks. But it was actually clearing out my pores and by the end of the first month I was hooked. I use water in the morning to rinse my face then I put this on before doing make up. At night time after shower I put it on again. My face no longer has little white bumps no more black heads on my nose. It works amazing just wish it was cheaper I found it on sale once but now I'm hooked and cannot not get it. Ps I'm 29 with oily semi acne prone skin

I have dry, very sensitive skin combines with hormonal acne (mid 30's). I use this daily over my entire face and follow it with the COSRX hyaluronic acid intensive cream. I get zero redness and this is the calmest my skin has been in 5+ years. Love this product!!!

Having mature oily reactive skin I try to play it safe. Which results in not always finding a product that actually improves my skin. Not the case here. BHA Blackhead Power Liquid is making a deep down difference. Smooth fresh skin every day.
